title: Project 2 · Count tasks by status
prompt: TaskItem is supplied. Each task has a Status such as "open", "done" or "blocked". Write public static Dictionary<string, int> CountByStatus(List<TaskItem> tasks). Return each status that appears with the number of tasks that have it. A status with no tasks is not a key, and an empty list gives an empty dictionary.
hints: Which value of a task decides the group it belongs to?
Each status needs one count that grows by 1 for every task with that status.
Group by Status and count each group, or loop and add 1 to a dictionary entry, starting a new status at 1.
checkLabels: Three different statuses appear, so there must be three keys.
A status that no task has must not be a key.
An empty list must give an empty dictionary.

wrongAnswers.misconception: Groups by owner instead of status.
Stores 1 for a status however many tasks have it.

feedback: Count the open tasks in the failing list by hand, then check which value you group by and how each count grows.
